T: The Easter Bunny's son wants to drum.
D: The Easter Bunny's son runs away to Hollywood to be a drummer instead of taking over the family business.
P: Serve the sweets when the Easter Island candy factory comes into view.
S: Milk chocolate with mini marshmallows and jellybeans

Milk chocolate rocky road packed with marshmallows, jellybeans, crunchy pretzels and coconut, cut into chunky squares. Line a 20cm square tin with baking paper. Melt 400g milk chocolate with 20g butter in a bowl over simmering water. Cool for 5 minutes. Stir in 100g mini marshmallows, 100g jellybeans, 60g broken pretzels and 30g shredded coconut. Spread into the tin, press another handful of jellybeans on top and chill for 2 hours until set. Cut into 16 squares with a hot knife.
Rainbow carrots with green goddess dip
Rainbow baby carrots and snow peas with avocado herb dip

Rainbow baby carrots and snow peas with a bright green herb, avocado and yoghurt dip and a sprinkle of toasted seeds. Trim 2 bunches rainbow baby carrots, leaving a little green top, and halve any big ones lengthways. Blanch 150g snow peas for 30 seconds and cool in iced water. Blitz 1 avocado, 150g Greek yoghurt, a handful each of basil, parsley and chives, the juice of 1 lemon and salt until smooth. Spoon into a bowl, scatter with 1 tbsp toasted sunflower seeds and serve with the vegetables.
M: Fred O'Hare's Hollywood loaded hot dogs
Hot dogs with cheddar sauce, corn relish and crispy onions

Grilled frankfurts in toasted buns loaded with cheesy sauce, crispy fried onions, sweet corn relish and a squeeze of tomato sauce. Simmer 8 frankfurts for 5 minutes, then grill 2 minutes until marked. Melt 20g butter, stir in 1 tbsp flour, whisk in 200ml milk and simmer until thick, then stir in 100g grated cheddar. Mix 200g drained corn kernels with 2 tbsp tomato relish. Toast 8 hot dog buns and fill with frankfurts, cheese sauce, corn relish and tomato sauce, then top with 4 tbsp crispy fried onions.
W: Milk chocolate and cornflake nests baked in muffin cases

Crunchy milk chocolate and cornflake nests filled with mini speckled eggs, with a little fluffy chick on top of a few. Melt 200g milk chocolate with 30g butter and 1 tbsp golden syrup. Stir in 80g cornflakes until coated. Spoon into 12 paper cases in a muffin tin, pressing a dip in the centre of each with the back of a teaspoon. Chill for 1 hour until set. Fill each nest with 3 mini chocolate eggs from a 150g bag and add a little decoration chick to a few.
K: Fresh carrot, orange and ginger juice with raspberry cordial

Freshly juiced carrot and orange with a touch of ginger, poured over ice with a splash of raspberry cordial sinking to the bottom like a sunrise. Juice 6 carrots, 4 oranges and a 2cm piece of ginger, or blend with 200ml water and strain through a sieve. Chill for 20 minutes. Fill 4 glasses with ice and pour in the juice. Slowly pour 1 tbsp raspberry cordial down the inside of each glass so it sinks to the bottom. Garnish with an orange wheel.
